data.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak it and use it to leave hidden messages; a creature that knows Druidic can automatically spot such a message.
data.note: Grants the Druidic language. v0 surfaces this as a language proficiency flag; full language tracking isn't yet wired through derive.ts.

data.description: You cast druid spells using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability. You can prepare a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level after each Long Rest.
Choose one of two callings that shaped your druidic training: Magician or Warden. Each grants a different set of additional proficiencies or abilities.
data.note: SRD 5.2: Choose Magician or Warden at L1. Player pick stored in character.featureChoices.primal-order.feature.feature; the chosen sub-feature row is loaded by the engine.

data.description: You learn one additional druid cantrip. You also add your Wisdom modifier to all Intelligence (Arcana) and Intelligence (Nature) checks.
data.note: SRD 5.2 Magician: Extra druid cantrip (pick from SRD druid cantrips) + add Wisdom modifier to all Arcana and Nature checks. Wis bonus to both skills is wired directly.

data.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training in Medium armor.
data.note: SRD 5.2 Warden: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training in Medium armor.

data.description: You can expend a use of Wild Shape to cast Find Familiar without material components, summoning a Fey spirit familiar. The familiar disappears after a number of hours equal to half your druid level.
data.note: Expend a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar (as a ritual) summoning a Fey spirit for 1 hour. The Find Familiar effect isn't simulated by v0; the resource and a utility activity are surfaced.

data.description: As a Bonus Action, you magically transform into a Beast you have seen whose Challenge Rating is at or below a limit set by your druid level. You revert to your normal form when you drop to 0 Hit Points, when the form's Hit Points drop to 0, or when you choose to end it as a Bonus Action. You have 2 uses, which you regain after a Short or Long Rest.
data.note: Full statblock replacement is out-of-scope for v0 (see docs/rules-engine.md What v0 does not handle). The resource and a utility activity are surfaced; the actual form/CR table isn't modelled.

data.description: You choose a Druid Circle that reflects your connection to nature, granting you additional features at levels 3, 6, 10, and 14.
data.note: Placeholder for Druid Circle selection (Land / Moon / Sea / Stars in 2024 SRD 5.2). The chosen subclass slug lives on character.classes[].subclass.

data.description: Once per turn, if you have no Wild Shape uses remaining, you can expend a spell slot of any level to regain one use. Additionally, once per Long Rest, you can expend one Wild Shape use to regain one expended level-1 spell slot.
data.note: Two legs: (A) Once per turn, if you have no Wild Shape uses remaining, you can expend a spell slot of any level to regain one Wild Shape use — this is unlimited but gated per-turn; (B) Once per Long Rest, expend one Wild Shape use to regain one expended level-1 spell slot. v0 surfaces leg B as a 1/long-rest utility activity; leg A (per-turn, spell-slot-funded) is left to UI adjudication and cannot be expressed in the current activity DSL.

activities.name: Wild Resurgence (regain spell slot from Wild Shape)
activities.note: Expend 1 Wild Shape use to regain a level-1 spell slot. Once per Long Rest.
